# Components

119 `component` items in the component registry.

## @cyclone-ui/accordion

A collapsible Accordion compound component (Accordion.Item, Item.Header, Header.Heading, Item.Content) built on Tamagui's accordion. It supports single or multiple open items, the Container variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, outlined, sunken, canvas, surface, elevated, floating) and ghost, shadow, glass, noise and accented options, separated and borderless layouts, numbered headers, toggle or chevron icons with a configurable side, and an up or down direction. Use it for FAQs or grouped sections that users expand.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/accordion`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@cyclone-ui/container@0.6.81`
- `@cyclone-ui/heading-text@0.5.77`
- `@cyclone-ui/icons@0.0.77`
- `@stryke/type-checks@^0.6.50`

- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/group@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/helpers@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/react-native-types@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/stacks@3.3.2`

## @cyclone-ui/address-input

An address search field: a SearchInput whose suggestions come from an address search API endpoint (GET <endpoint>?q=<text> returning label/latitude/longitude options), with a map of the chosen address. It provides Map, Search and TextBox parts; the map sits outside the Field so a floating label still lines up.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/address-input`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@cyclone-ui/body-text@0.5.76`
- `@cyclone-ui/context-menu@0.0.74`
- `@cyclone-ui/helpers@0.3.77`
- `@cyclone-ui/icons@0.0.77`
- `@cyclone-ui/search-input@0.1.86`
- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/image@3.3.2`

### Files

| Path                                            | Type        | Target |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------ |
| `components/address-input/src/AddressInput.tsx` | `component` | —      |

### Props

#### `AddressInputExtraProps`

| Prop              | Type                                | Default | Required | Description                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `endpoint`        | `string`                            | —       | Yes      | The address search API. While the user types it is sent `GET \<endpoint>?q=\<text>`, and answers with a JSON array of \{@link AddressOption}s. |
| `defaultAddress`  | `AddressOption`                     | —       | No       | The address shown before one is chosen, such as a saved address.                                                                               |
| `onAddressChange` | `(address?: AddressOption) => void` | —       | No       | Called when an address is chosen, and with `undefined` once the text is edited away from it.                                                   |

#### `AddressInputMapExtraProps`

| Prop          | Type     | Default | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------- | -------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `zoom`        | `number` | `15`    | No       | The map zoom level, from 0 (the world) to 19 (a building).                                                                                                                           |
| `tileUrl`     | `string` | —       | No       | The 256px raster tile URL, with `\{z}`, `\{x}` and `\{y}` placeholders. OpenStreetMap's tiles are for light use only; set your own provider's (and its `attribution`) in production. |
| `attribution` | `string` | —       | No       | The credit the tile provider requires on its map.                                                                                                                                    |

## @cyclone-ui/alert

An inline alert banner with compound parts (Alert.Icon, Alert.Content.Heading, Alert.Content.Body, Alert.Close). Its type prop (base, brand, danger, warning, info, success, discovery, positive, negative) sets the color theme and default icon. Use it to show status or feedback messages in the page.

## @cyclone-ui/anchor

A heading wrapper that renders its children next to a permalink icon. The icon shows on hover or focus and links to href on web, or opens the URL with Linking on native. Use it to make headings and sections deep-linkable.

## @cyclone-ui/area-chart

A composable area chart built on Recharts and the shared Cyclone chart parts. Areas can overlap, stack or expand to 100%, use gradient, solid, dotted, lines or hatched fills, and take dashed or animated strokes, point markers and a reveal animation. It also supports a zoom brush, legend selection and a loading skeleton. Use it to show how values change over time and how series add up.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/area-chart`
- **Type:** `component`

## @cyclone-ui/article-page

An ArticlePage layout compound component for blog posts and documentation articles. A Header on its own background holds the breadcrumb, title, summary, cover Media and a Details row with the byline, Share links and tags; it stays in place while the Main sheet scrolls up over it. Main holds the article Content, beside a sticky table of contents and share links on wide screens, and Sections for feedback and recommendations, followed by the page footer.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/article-page`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

## @cyclone-ui/article-progress-header

A sticky, horizontally scrolling strip of an article's section links, like a docs page's mobile section bar. A dot slides to the section the reader is in as they scroll, the strip keeps that link in view and fades its edges while there is more to scroll to, and its motion respects reduced motion. Built on the TableOfContents scroll tracking, with a blurred translucent canvas background.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/article-progress-header`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@cyclone-ui/body-text@0.5.76`
- `@cyclone-ui/table-of-contents@0.0.78`
- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`

| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------- | ------ |

### Props

| ------- | -------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items` | `readonly TableOfContentsItem[]` | —       | Yes      | The article's sections in document order; each `url` is a hash link. |

## @cyclone-ui/avatar

An Avatar that shows an image at a fixed size, round or with rounded corners, and falls back to the person's initials or an icon while the image loads or when it is missing. A status prop adds a Badge dot on the bottom-right edge, cut out of the avatar by a transparent ring. An editable avatar reveals an upload button on hover, then opens a crop modal (drag to pan, slider to zoom, over a grid with stronger center lines) and passes the cropped square image to onUpload.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/avatar`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@cyclone-ui/badge@0.3.82`
- `@cyclone-ui/body-text@0.5.76`
- `@cyclone-ui/button@0.6.82`
- `@cyclone-ui/icons@0.0.77`
- `@cyclone-ui/modal@0.0.48`
- `@cyclone-ui/slider@0.0.80`
- `@cyclone-ui/spinner@0.5.76`
- `@tamagui/avatar@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`

### Files

| Path                                        | Type        | Target |
| ------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ------ |
| `components/avatar/src/Avatar.tsx`          | `component` | —      |
| `components/avatar/src/AvatarCropModal.tsx` | `component` | —      |
| `components/avatar/src/utilities.ts`        | `file`      | —      |

### Props

#### `AvatarProps`

| Prop          | Type                                    | Default | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src`         | `string \| null`                        | —       | No       | The image URL. The fallback shows while it loads, and when it is missing or fails.                                                                                                                 |
| `name`        | `string`                                | —       | No       | The person's name: the image's alt text, and the source of the fallback initials.                                                                                                                  |
| `size`        | `AvatarSize`                            | `"md"`  | No       | The avatar's size.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `circular`    | `boolean`                               | `true`  | No       | Round the avatar (and its crop window). `false` gives rounded corners.                                                                                                                             |
| `fallback`    | `ReactNode`                             | —       | No       | Replaces the default fallback (the `name` initials, or a person icon).                                                                                                                             |
| `status`      | `BadgeColor`                            | —       | No       | Shows a status dot (a `Badge` in this color, such as `"success"` for online) on the bottom-right edge, cut out of the avatar by a transparent ring.                                                |
| `statusLabel` | `string`                                | —       | No       | Describes the status to screen readers (such as "Online"), since the dot itself is hidden from them.                                                                                               |
| `editable`    | `boolean`                               | `false` | No       | Show an upload button on hover that picks an image, crops it, and passes the result to `onUpload`. Web only.                                                                                       |
| `onUpload`    | `(file: File) => void \| Promise<void>` | —       | No       | Called with the cropped, square image (at most 512px). The avatar shows it right away, and while a returned promise is pending it shows a spinner. A rejected promise restores the previous image. |

| `circular` | `boolean`              | —       | Yes      | Shows a round crop window instead of a square one.   |
| `onCancel` | `() => void`           | —       | Yes      | —                                                    |
| `onCrop`   | `(file: File) => void` | —       | Yes      | Called with the cropped, square image.               |

## @cyclone-ui/badge

A Badge that wraps an element and pins a small count or dot to one of its corners. It follows MUI's API: anchorOrigin, max (shows 99+ by default), showZero, invisible, rectangular or circular overlap, standard or dot variants, and palette or theme colors. Use it for notification counts and status indicators.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/badge`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@cyclone-ui/state@0.0.79`
- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`

### Files

| Path                             | Type        | Target |
| -------------------------------- | ----------- | ------ |
| `components/badge/src/Badge.tsx` | `component` | —      |

### Props

| Prop           | Type                                                                    | Default                                      | Required | Description                                                                                                                              |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `anchorOrigin` | `BadgeOrigin`                                                           | `\{ vertical: "top", horizontal: "right" \}` | No       | The corner of the wrapped element the badge is centered on                                                                               |
| `badgeContent` | `ReactNode`                                                             | —                                            | No       | The content rendered within the badge                                                                                                    |
| `children`     | `ReactNode`                                                             | —                                            | No       | The element the badge is added to                                                                                                        |
| `color`        | `BadgeColor`                                                            | `"default"`                                  | No       | The color of the badge                                                                                                                   |
| `invisible`    | `boolean`                                                               | `false`                                      | No       | Should the badge be hidden                                                                                                               |
| `max`          | `number`                                                                | `99`                                         | No       | The largest count to show; higher counts show as `$\{max}+`                                                                              |
| `overlap`      | `BadgeOverlap`                                                          | `"rectangular"`                              | No       | The shape the badge overlaps                                                                                                             |
| `pulse`        | `boolean`                                                               | `false`                                      | No       | Should the badge pulse, drawing attention with a ring that repeatedly expands out of it and fades (web only, skipped for reduced motion) |
| `showZero`     | `boolean`                                                               | `false`                                      | No       | Should the badge show when `badgeContent` is zero                                                                                        |
| `variant`      | `BadgeVariant`                                                          | `"standard"`                                 | No       | The variant to use                                                                                                                       |
| `slots`        | `{ root?: ElementType; badge?: ElementType; }`                          | —                                            | No       | The components used for each slot                                                                                                        |
| `slotProps`    | `{ root?: Partial<BadgeRootProps>; badge?: Partial<BadgeBadgeProps>; }` | —                                            | No       | The props used for each slot                                                                                                             |

## @cyclone-ui/body-text

A themed paragraph text component built on Tamagui's SizableText that renders a p element using the body typography tokens. It has md and sm sizes and an optional bold weight. Use it for standard body copy and as a base for other text components.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/body-text`
- **Type:** `component`

## @cyclone-ui/button

A pressable button with Button.Text and Button.Icon subcomponents and the Container variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, outlined, sunken, canvas, surface, elevated, floating), whose background is drawn by a Container, plus ghost, link and cascade hover variants. ## @cyclone-ui/color-compositions

An animated display component reproducing Ellsworth Kelly's "Colors for a Large Wall" as a grid of colored panels. The grid fits as many `panelSize` panels as the component's dimensions allow, tiling the painting when larger. Pairs of differently colored panels swap places on an `interval` (in milliseconds) with a short color fade; `0` or a reduced-motion preference holds the panels still.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/color-compositions`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

## @cyclone-ui/container

A themed surface Container that wraps content in a padded, rounded box. Variants include primary, secondary, tertiary, outlined, sunken, canvas, surface, elevated (the default) and floating. ## @cyclone-ui/context-menu

A ContextMenu that shows a list of actions in a popover on large screens and a bottom sheet on small screens. It has Trigger, Anchor, Content, Content.ScrollView, Item and Item.Text parts, a sm, md or lg size, and the Container variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, outlined, sunken, canvas, surface, elevated, floating) with the popover's shadow, glass, noise and accented options. Items show a check mark when their value matches the menu's value and a lock when disabled; an Item can also be shown as highlighted while focus stays elsewhere (a combobox's active option), take a `theme` that colors its text and icons with that theme's primary tokens, and list child `items` in a submenu behind a right chevron (expanded inline in the small-screen sheet). Use it for dropdown menus and pickers such as the country selector in PhoneNumberInputField.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/context-menu`

## @cyclone-ui/error-page

A full-width error page block for an HTTP status code. ## @cyclone-ui/icons

Animated Tamagui icon components for web and React Native covering the Material Line Icons (line-md) collection, plus the createIcon factory used to build them. Each icon is themed, draws itself in on mount, and accepts color, size (pixels or tokens), mirrored, animated, and a variant of regular, bold, loop, filled or filled-loop. Includes custom SVG graphics under the vectors entry point.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/icons`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@cyclone-ui/helpers@0.3.77`
- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/helpers@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/helpers-icon@3.3.2`
- `@tamagui/helpers-tamagui@3.3.2`
- `motion@^11.18.2`
- `react-native-svg@^15.16.1`

## @cyclone-ui/illustrations

Isometric line illustrations that answer the pointer, built on the Hairline engine and painted with Cyclone UI theme tokens. Includes the createIllustration factory (react-native-svg, so one illustration runs on web, React Native and the server), the illustration engine (HL), and thirty-three illustrations: Hairline's figures, from Basket to Vault. Each takes intensity, animated, play, label, onRead, strokeWidth and palette props.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/illustrations`
- **Type:** `component`

### Props

| Prop          | Type                                  | Default | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity`   | `number`                              | `0.5`   | No       | How strongly the illustration answers, from 0 to 1: the slider of the bench, mapped onto the illustration's own `range`.                                                              |
| `animated`    | `boolean`                             | `true`  | No       | Answer the pointer and move. `false` draws the rest pose, still.                                                                                                                      |
| `play`        | `boolean`                             | —       | No       | Walk the illustration's tour with an unseen pointer until a real one arrives.                                                                                                         |
| `label`       | `string`                              | —       | No       | The accessible label. Defaults to what the illustration `means`.                                                                                                                      |
| `onRead`      | `(text: string) => void`              | —       | No       | Hears the read-out: what is under the pointer, or "rest".                                                                                                                             |
| `strokeWidth` | `number`                              | `0.9`   | No       | The stroke width in pixels. Strokes do not scale with the drawing.                                                                                                                    |
| `palette`     | `Partial<Record<PaletteKey, string>>` | —       | No       | Overrides one of the palette's five colours with a theme token name (`"surface"`) or a colour. Set `plate` to the surface the illustration sits on, so its solids are filled with it. |

## @cyclone-ui/privacy-choices

A "Your Privacy Choices" link, marked with the California privacy options icon, that opens a Dialog where users review their privacy rights and turn categories of cookies or data sharing on or off. ## @cyclone-ui/rating

Hover changes are reported through onChangeActive. Wrapped in a Field, it connects to the form: it reads its value, size and disabled state from the field and reports changes to it.

## @cyclone-ui/search-dialog

A search icon Button that opens a Dialog for searching the application, like the fumadocs search dialog. It also opens with ⌘K / Ctrl+K. A debounced `search` function (static index or API) returns page, heading and text results with breadcrumbs and highlighted query words, narrowed by optional filter toggles under the search box. The arrow keys move through the results and Enter opens one. The last results chosen are saved in localStorage and listed as "Recent" when it opens, where they can be removed one by one or cleared. A footer shows the keyboard shortcuts as `Kbd` keys, with an optional settings button in its corner.

## @cyclone-ui/tabs

Defaults to `subtle`.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `hoveredBackgroundColor` | `string`                                         | —       | No       | The indicator color while hovered, unpressed and `borderless` without a `variant`. Defaults to none.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

## @cyclone-ui/toggle-group

A clickable group of toggle components that exists in either an "on" or "off" state, with the Container variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, outlined, sunken, canvas, surface, elevated, floating) drawn on its indicators, shadow styles and various styles and sizes.

### Dependencies

#### `ToggleGroupProps`

| Prop            | Type                                          | Default | Required | Description                                                                                                        |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `multiple`      | `boolean`                                     | —       | No       | Allow more than one toggle to be selected at a time. The value is then a `string[]` instead of a `string \| null`. |
| `value`         | `string \| string[] \| null`                  | —       | No       | The selected value(s). Makes the group controlled.                                                                 |
| `defaultValue`  | `string \| string[] \| null`                  | —       | No       | The initial selection when uncontrolled.                                                                           |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string \| string[] \| null) => void` | —       | No       | Called with the new selection when a toggle is pressed.                                                            |

| `readOnly`      | `boolean`                                     | —       | No       | Prevent selection changes without applying disabled colors.                                                        |
| `fluid`         | `boolean`                                     | —       | No       | Span the parent's width, sharing it evenly between the toggles.                                                    |
| `borderless`    | `boolean`                                     | —       | No       | Drop the shared frame's border and background.                                                                     |

## @cyclone-ui/topographic-background

A full-bleed topographic map background for the web. The interactive variant follows the light or dark theme, gently warps the contour lines with WebGL and paints the colored map in under the cursor, respecting reduced motion. Static dark, light and color variants show the image alone with no motion or hover effect.

- **Name:** `@cyclone-ui/topographic-background`
- **Type:** `component`

### Dependencies

- `@tamagui/core@3.3.2`

## @cyclone-ui/validation-text

A ValidationText component that shows field validation messages in caption text with an enter/exit animation. A single message is shown as plain text.
